sourceConflicts.summary: The Domain Expansion overview lists Idle Death Gamble as 120s, while the current Restless Gambler page lists 80s and says it breaks after 4 scenarios. The dataset uses the individual character page for the row and keeps the Jackpot duration in effect text.

The domain overview uses Self-Embodiment of Perfection in one table row, while the individual Perfection page and local character dataset use Embodiment of Self Perfection. The dataset uses the individual-page name and records the conflict in notes.

The Black Death page verifies Infestation as an awakening variant that invades and breaks a domain border, but the Domain Expansion table does not list it as a domain. It is kept as a rule note, not a row.
BloxGuidesGG describes generic level-threshold domain unlocks and different hotkeys. Those claims conflict with the official/local controls and are not used for row data.

ruleNotes.name: Black Death Infestation
ruleNotes.summary: Verified as a domain-border invasion variant that uses roaches to eat away at a dome until it breaks. It stays out of the 10-row count because it is not listed as its own Domain Expansion row.

ruleNotes.name: Domain break rules
ruleNotes.summary: Domain walls can be damaged from outside by specific terrain-destruction moves. Players trapped inside generally need to kill the caster unless a verified exception applies.

ruleNotes.name: Domain clash rules
ruleNotes.summary: Simultaneous domains disable sure-hit effects during the clash. Contestants build a bar through hits, and the winner keeps their domain while the others are canceled.

items.name: Infinite Void
items.trigger: Use the Infinite Void domain move during Six Eyes.
items.effect: Caught enemies are unable to act for the full duration, though actions already started before the effect can continue.
items.counterplay: Cancel Honored One during windup, break the domain from outside, or kill the caster if trapped inside.
items.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade the border and disable the stun while the portal is active.
items.notes: Normal domain windup rules apply. One of the sure-hit effects explicitly disabled by Chimera Shadow Garden.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Honored One page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Malevolent Shrine
items.trigger: Use Malevolent Shrine during King of Curses.
items.effect: Constant slashes hit everyone inside for 2 HP per slash, or 0.5 HP while blocking, for up to 218 HP over the domain.
items.counterplay: Blocking reduces slash damage and prevents slash executions, but the caster can still pressure block. Outside players can break the domain; trapped players need to kill the caster.
items.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade and disable the slash sure-hit while active.
items.notes: The individual Vessel page confirms the 18s duration, 120s cooldown, and slash values.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Vessel page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Embodiment of Self Perfection
items.trigger: Use Embodiment of Self Perfection during Essence of the Soul.
items.effect: Targets get a transfiguration meter that drains faster near the caster or when the caster damages them. Emptying the meter kills through transfiguration.
items.counterplay: Cancel the longer windup, break the domain from outside, or kill the caster if trapped. Domain Amplification can nullify the transfiguration, but the meter drain still matters.
items.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade and disable the transfiguration meter drain while active.
items.notes: You may also see this written as Self-Embodiment of Perfection.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Perfection page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Authentic Mutual Love
items.trigger: Use Authentic Mutual Love during True Love.
items.effect: Katanas fall inside the domain. Picking one up lets the caster swing a copied technique; landing four katanas unlocks Jacob's Ladder.
items.counterplay: Cancel the longer windup, avoid or punish katana swings, and note that the domain breaks immediately if it catches no enemies.
items.clashInvasionRule: It has no special clash reward. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable it because there is no sure-hit effect to turn off.
items.notes: Jacob's Ladder can be used once per domain after four landed katana swings and drains health plus awakening progress.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Cursed Partners page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Time Cell Moon Palace
items.trigger: Use Time Cell Moon Palace during Vengeance.
items.effect: Opponents must follow the 24 FPS rule. Acting other than blocking freezes and shatters their cells, with damage based on movement speed.
items.counterplay: Cancel the windup, stop acting inside except to block, break the domain from outside, or kill the caster if trapped.
items.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade and disable the frame-shatter sure-hit while active.
items.notes: Casting ends the awakening route and returns the user to their base moveset.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Head of the Hei page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Idle Death Gamble
items.trigger: Activating Restless Gambler's awakening casts the domain.
items.effect: The caster uses visual moves to trigger Richii scenarios and roll for Jackpot. A normal Jackpot lasts 100s; pity Jackpot lasts 50s.
items.counterplay: The windup is uninterruptible, but anti-team burst can negate the startup stun. The domain can fail if scenarios do not hit Jackpot before it breaks.
items.clashInvasionRule: Winning a domain clash skips the first Richii scenario and immediately grants a 100s Jackpot. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable it.
items.notes: The important fight timer is the 80s scenario window. Jackpot itself lasts 100s, or 50s if it is the pity Jackpot.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Restless Gambler page checked on 2026-05-31; duration conflict recorded.

items.name: Deadly Sentencing
items.trigger: Activating Defense Attorney's awakening expands the domain.
items.effect: Everyone inside becomes invulnerable for a trial minigame. Outcomes can return awakening, confiscate moves or held items, unlock Death Penalty, or do both.
items.counterplay: The windup is uninterruptible. Defendants answer the trial choices; six opposing choices immediately end the trial.
items.clashInvasionRule: Winning a domain clash starts Deadly Sentencing with one Judgement Bar segment prefilled. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable it.
items.notes: Confiscation can remove moves for 90s and items permanently. The domain breaks if no target is caught.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Defense Attorney page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: 0.2 Domain
items.trigger: Use the special during the Six Eyes awakening sequence.
items.effect: Expands Infinite Void over double the normal range for half the normal exposure, then turns into a three-phase rush.
items.counterplay: Can be canceled during windup and sometimes during the rush when i-frames drop. The horizontal rush can be punished after it ends.
items.clashInvasionRule: It has no special clash reward. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable 0.2 Domain.
items.notes: The Honored One page says the full rush can total 220 damage if every phase connects, then burns the user back to base cooldowns.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Honored One page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Chimera Shadow Garden
items.trigger: Use Shadow Swarm against a domain border.
items.effect: Creates a shadow tunnel through a domain wall, letting everyone except the Ten Shadows user enter or leave while selected sure-hit effects are disabled.
items.counterplay: Hit Ten Shadows, wait out the HP drain, or force them to close the portal. Maintaining the invasion drains 4 HP per second.
items.clashInvasionRule: Disables Infinite Void, Malevolent Shrine, Embodiment of Self Perfection, and Time Cell Moon Palace while active.
items.notes: Does not affect 0.2 Domain, Idle Death Gamble, Deadly Sentencing, Authentic Mutual Love, or Incomplete Shrine.
items.imageStatus: local still frame from row-specific wiki domain GIF
items.verificationNote: Domain table and Ten Shadows page checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Incomplete Shrine
items.effect: A borderless shrine targets the map with relentless slashes. Each slash deals 3 HP, or 0.5 HP while blocked.
items.counterplay: Strongest Of History is restricted to Roulette, game admin, FSD, or private-server access. The domain lacks a normal border, so outside-wall break counterplay does not apply.
items.clashInvasionRule: Destroys other active domains inside its destruction range. Chimera Shadow Garden does not affect it because it lacks a normal border.
items.availability: Roulette, Game Admin, FSD, and Private Server exclusive
items.notes: Label as restricted/special. It has extreme range, but preparation is required because it can be canceled.
